title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 7:13-14
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 7:13-14</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).

<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="13" /> Enter through the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">narrow</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">gate</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        Because <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">wide is the</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">gate</char>, and broad 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">is the road that leads to ruin</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
        and those who enter through it are many. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="14" /> How <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">narrow is the</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">gate</char>, and constricted, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">is the road that leads to life</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
        and those who find it are few. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
